follow-up time: Variable, up to approximately 4 years based on study period
exposure: Absence of crying immediately after birth
cohort: 568 preterm neonates admitted to Mizan Tepi University Teaching Hospital NICU
finding: Preterm neonatal mortality was high (35%), with significant predictors including vaginal delivery, non-cephalic presentation, lack of ANC, low APGAR score, RDS, lack of KMC, delayed crying at birth, low birth weight, and hypothermia.
mod_finding: Vaginal mode of delivery was significantly associated with increased preterm mortality (AHR: 1.78, 95%CI: 1.05-3.08).
birth_weight: Low birth weight and VLBW were significantly associated with preterm mortality
